description: This file implements an OpenAPI v3 aggregator for Kubernetes, managing APIService proxies, merging OpenAPI specs from multiple sources, and handling discovery endpoints.

classes.name: specProxier
classes.description: Implements the SpecProxier interface, managing APIService OpenAPI specs, merging discovery info, and handling APIService updates.

classes.name: openAPIV3APIServiceInfo
classes.description: Holds information about an individual APIService, including its spec, handler, discovery info, and legacy status.

methods.name: GetAPIServiceNames
methods.description: Returns the list of APIService names currently managed.

methods.name: BuildAndRegisterAggregator
methods.description: Initializes and registers the OpenAPI aggregator, setting up handlers for local and delegated API services.

methods.name: AddUpdateAPIService
methods.description: Adds or updates an APIService's handler and info in the aggregator.

methods.name: UpdateAPIServiceSpec
methods.description: Updates the OpenAPI spec for a given APIService, downloading and converting specs as needed.

methods.name: RemoveAPIServiceSpec
methods.description: Removes an APIService from the managed specs.

methods.name: getOpenAPIV3Root
methods.description: Merges discovery info from all APIServices into a single OpenAPI v3 discovery object.

methods.name: handleDiscovery
methods.description: Serves the OpenAPI v3 discovery document.

methods.name: handleGroupVersion
methods.description: Serves the OpenAPI v3 spec for a specific group/version.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the discovery and group/version handlers with the HTTP multiplexer.
